purpose: Define the stable player-species aggregate boundary without creating a species-specific mechanics engine or duplicating shared biological/entity truth.
source_basis: PROJECT_BIBLE_OPS3_REFERENCE.md §25.2-25.6 species/form/adaptation separation and species grant/reference model
PROJECT_BIBLE_OPS3_REFERENCE.md §9.3-9.6 character creation, validation and migration
PROJECT_BIBLE_OPS3_REFERENCE.md §10.1-10.4 character aggregate, state distinctions, grant provenance and derived rules

owns: player-species aggregate identity and composition envelope

lifecycle_note: The controlling character lifecycle requires distinctions beyond a single active/inactive flag and leaves the exact enum to implementation. This species-record enum is the MVPS-01 implementation contract; later validation/migration tranches may add transition rules without collapsing these distinctions.

identity.rule: species_id is stable identity; presentation/name changes do not mint a new identity unless canon declares a distinct species record

versioning.rule: character selections pin exact species record version; incompatible evolution is handled through migration rather than silent substitution

provenance.rule: missing or conflicting canon remains explicit and is never fabricated

lifecycle_state.rule: state is explicit and is not represented by a single active boolean

taxonomy.rule: taxonomy can classify/link the species but cannot directly execute rules

setting_scope.rule: setting/lore applicability is referenced and does not encode campaign mutation

biology_descriptor.rule: physical/biological description may state authored facts; any executable survival, resistance, sense, movement or capability effect must be expressed through a typed shared-record grant/reference

grants.rule: grant entries identify shared records; they do not duplicate formulas, actions, effects or resource logic

lineage_refs.rule: lineages/subspecies remain distinct layers and do not overwrite base species identity

form_refs.rule: forms remain distinct governed body/state configurations and do not overwrite base species identity

progression_refs.rule: species progression is optional and uses the shared progression system

lore_culture_links.rule: culture/lore links do not become biological mechanics

presentation_assets.rule: presentation/assets cannot redefine hidden mechanical or lore facts

extension_policy.collision_rule: extensions may add namespaced data but cannot shadow, replace or reinterpret reserved MVPS core fields
extension_policy.promotion_rule: an extension becomes canonical core behavior only through a versioned contract change
